[Second-Bianchi form of the commutator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0243 ↗ lem:chow-ii-nabla-laplacian-commutator 1. ch13:13.23\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

The second Bianchi identity rewrites the derivative-curvature term as \[ ( abla \Delta -\Delta abla )A \preccurlyeq n(2\ell +1)\Rm * abla A+2\ell abla \Ric *A. \]
